request: When is the Highway Trust Fund projected to run short of money?
escalation_reason: The quick pass verified only 1 fact(s).

reply.reply:
The newest CRS projection, using CBO’s February 2026 baseline, indicates the Highway Trust Fund could face payment delays starting in **Q3 FY2027 for FTA** and **Q2 FY2028 for FHWA** (CRS R47573, PDF p. 11). Its combined year-end balance/shortfall projection turns negative in FY2028 (CRS R47573, PDF p. 12). These are different measures: agency payment-delay timing versus the combined balance projection; the report notes the HTF may not incur negative balances under current law.

[View the cited brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-190547-96e1.html)
reply.reasoning: The newest verified evidence directly answers timing, distinguishing account-specific payment delays from the combined HTF balance turning negative. Cite CRS R47573 and avoid asserting an exact date for the balance projection beyond FY2028.
